cases.expected: non‑null TradingRecord instance containing the trades generated by the strategy between indexes 0 and 10

cases.expected: non‑null TradingRecord instance with zero trades (empty record)
cases.description: Edge case where startIndex equals finishIndex. No bars are processed, so the resulting TradingRecord should be empty but not null.
Invalid range: startIndex is greater than finishIndex. The method is expected to validate the range and throw an IllegalArgumentException.
Negative startIndex should be rejected. The method should throw an IllegalArgumentException indicating that indexes must be non‑negative.
Null Strategy argument. The method must not accept a null strategy and should throw a NullPointerException (or a custom IllegalArgumentException) before delegating.
Start index exceeds the size of the underlying BarSeries. The method should detect the out‑of‑range index and throw an IndexOutOfBoundsException.
Finish index exceeds the size of the BarSeries. The method should validate the upper bound and throw an IndexOutOfBoundsException.
Negative finishIndex should be rejected. The method must validate that both indexes are non‑negative and throw IllegalArgumentException before any processing.
